aaa.reason: All seventeen Rust contract tests use explicit Arrange, Act, and Assert phases across state identity, codec boundaries, profile and context binding, object-pin membership, and creating-release lifecycle outcomes; the isolated pytest launcher asserts the exact Rust and compile-fail totals.

reject_is_noop.reason: State and occurrence binders consume immutable references and return typed errors without constructing a witness, selecting another route, applying an effect, changing state, persisting replay data, or exposing publication authority.

accept a lane count other than twelve or accept duplicate or reordered lanes

nonclaims: GlobalEconomicStateV1 commits named roots and checks implemented structural relations. It does not prove conservation, custody, liabilities, reserves, terminal obligations, outbox semantics, or lane transition correctness.

An EconomicObjectReleasePinV1 membership proof authenticates creating-release metadata against one state root. It does not derive the command's route or distinguish new-object purpose from existing-object drain purpose.

RegistryBoundGlobalEconomicStateV1 and StateBoundEconomicCommandOccurrenceV1 are in-memory structural witnesses. They are not RISC0 receipts, current-head witnesses, verified epochs, settlement capabilities, or publication authority.
No Python semantic refinement, Tau, Lean, Kani, SMT, guest, release-aware verifier, migration, ZenoLedger commit, API, UI, or value-moving mount is added.
No production-readiness, RC, formal-verification, whole-economy proof, or whole-economy settlement claim is promoted.
